name: Otoshima ~Shojo Kouryaku Hen~
source:
Kyohei's father is president of a big company. One day, he is given an order to succeed to his company. That is "to make virgin girls addicted to sex." If he makes it, he will become the next president.... Kyohei soon starts selecting his target girls....

[From ErogeShop]
